method: Median strongest-50ms RMS of the live game's six existing melee/bow cues, including the game master gain. Match toward that digital output at the board's 55% reference volume. Other volume settings scale normally. Current game cues reproduce their original relative gains; base/library profiles of authored quiet edits retain zero makeup gain. Event-specific attack and ordinary-terrain gains may adjust these to their corresponding game range.
eventRangePolicy: Clamp attack and ordinary-terrain events to their existing game min/max strongest-50ms RMS ranges; retain gains already in range. Quarry/mine and bell tiles retain their authored levels. Selection and shared movement are unchanged.
